inventory_scope: Frozen R3 included corpus and frozen R4 original-content locator evidence only; no discovery or added sources.

cross_paper_tensions.overlap_topic: whether sampled evaluation preserves conclusions from exact ranking evaluation
cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: Naive sampled metrics can change model ordering relative to exact evaluation.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: Sampling reliability depends on the estimator, strategy, metric, and sampling regime rather than on sampling as one undifferentiated practice.

cross_paper_tensions.overlap_topic: evaluation-setting sensitivity to candidate and split construction
cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: Alternative candidate and protocol settings can alter offline conclusions.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: Sequential model rankings can change under different data-splitting strategies.

cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: SASRec uses causal self-attention for next-item prediction.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: BERT4Rec uses bidirectional encoding with a masked-item Cloze objective.

cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: ItemCF aggregates evidence from item-item interaction overlap.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: BPR supplies a pairwise optimization criterion for implicit feedback.

cross_paper_tensions.overlap_topic: representation availability for items without observed collaborative edges
cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: LightGCN propagates trainable ID embeddings over the observed user-item graph.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: AlphaRec uses language representations under a paper-specific zero-shot recommendation protocol.

cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: Sentence-BERT evaluates sentence embeddings and does not supply a retail recommendation objective.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: AlphaRec evaluates language representations inside a recommender objective and ranking protocol.

cross_paper_tensions.overlap_topic: use of explicit cross or rule signals
cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: Wide & Deep combines engineered cross-product features with a deep component for its ranking task.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: Apriori mines association rules under support and confidence thresholds.

cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: The accepted Liu 2007 predecessor combines sequential-rule and collaborative-filtering scores; it is bound to method precedent only.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: Wide & Deep jointly trains linear cross-product and embedding/MLP components for a different ranking task.

cross_paper_tensions.overlap_topic: repeat and exploration behavior in next-basket recommendation
cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: Aggregate next-basket results can be dominated by repeat behavior and should be decomposed.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: Repeat/explore-aware modeling reports separate behavior and ablation results under its own data and protocol.

cross_paper_tensions.overlap_topic: transferable sequential item representation and target-domain adaptation
cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: UniSRec uses universal sequence representation learning followed by downstream adaptation.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: VQ-Rec uses vector-quantized item representations and evaluates transfer under a distinct adaptation setup.

cross_paper_tensions.overlap_topic: content-based cold-item representations aligned to collaborative signals
cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: Content representations aligned to collaborative teachers can inherit popularity structure.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: Sparse contrastive learning evaluates a content-based cold-item objective under paper-specific data and splits.

cross_paper_tensions.overlap_topic: protocol sensitivity in sequential recommendation evaluation
cross_paper_tensions.a_finding: Split design can affect model metrics and rankings.
cross_paper_tensions.b_finding: Implementation and training choices complicate BERT4Rec replicability and comparison.

coverage_note: 52 canonical scholarly records are in the frozen included corpus; 12 candidate pairs were considered using shared-RQ, shared-construct, bibliographic-coupling, scholar-flag, and cross-cluster signals. This is a scoped advisory scan, not complete pairwise contradiction detection. Cross-neighborhood pairs may be absent; bibliographic coupling was used only as an inclusion signal. Every emitted pair awaits scholar confirmation, and the scholar may add further cross-pairs during R6/user adjudication.
